title: Types Of Farming In India
definition: Types of farming in India encompass the diverse methods of agricultural production determined by physical environment, technological know-how, socio-economic conditions, and historical factors ranging from subsistence practices to high-tech commercial systems.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS-1 (Geography - Agricultural patterns, spatial distribution of crops), GS-3 (Indian Economy - Agriculture, food security, subsidies, farm distress, and supply chains), and Essay paper.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Types Of Farming In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
